newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Multicare taps NationsBank for ADS acquisition.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Multicare taps NationsBank for ADS acquisition.

text.p: NEW YORK, Nov 21 (LPC) - NationsBank Corp is in the syndicated loan market with a $350 million credit partially funding Multicare Cos Inc's acquisition of ADS Group, a privately held, long-term care company, banking sources said.

The 3.25-year loan is split between a $312 million revolving portion and a $38 million term loan, a banker said. Pricing starts at 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), the banker added.
The credit, which replaces a deal of identical size put in place by Chase Manhattan Bank in May, comes in conjunction with a KeyCorp -led synthetic lease, lenders said.
